sites.ownership: The document tools controller owns the mutable print runner injection point.
sites.justification: Print action tests replace only this scoped runner while runtime action state remains owned by the window-local controller.

sites.ownership: The Find in Files controller and scanner own one workspace scan generation, cancellable, and result set.
sites.justification: Async GIO enumeration and file loading complete across callbacks, so generation-checked shared state keeps late results out of the current UI without blocking the GTK main loop.

sites.justification: Folder root changes, hidden-filter updates, and sidebar integration must coordinate cancellables and handlers without synchronous filesystem probes.
